name: karnak
description: Jev picks the reasoning effort for every model request inside a Claude Code turn: more thinking when the next step is hard, less for routine steps. Ares-style per-step routing.

mode.title: Jev effort mode
mode.description: auto: Jev sets effort before every model request. off: the session's own effort is used.

ceiling.title: Effort ceiling
ceiling.description: Highest effort Jev may pick. session uses the session's configured effort as the ceiling. max is never picked: a session at max is capped at xhigh.

firstStepMinimum.title: First step minimum
firstStepMinimum.description: Minimum effort for the first model request of a turn, the one that reads the new prompt and plans.

subagents.title: Route subagent steps
subagents.description: Also pick effort for subagent model requests.

historyMessages.title: History messages
historyMessages.description: How many recent transcript messages Jev sees when deciding.

timeoutMs.title: Jev timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: If Jev has not answered by then, the step goes out at the session's effort.

confidenceFloor.title: Confidence floor
confidenceFloor.description: Below this Jev confidence the step keeps the session's effort.

showStatus.title: Show status line
showStatus.description: Pin the chosen effort under the prompt.

log.title: Log every decision
log.description: Write one transcript log line per routed step.

apiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.description: Leave unset to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY from the environment or settings env.
